title: Nourishing Garlicky Korean Myeongnan Roe Dumplings
description: A light and flavorful ovo-vegetarian dish featuring myeongnan-roe, served in a donabe, perfect for a nourishing meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine myeongnan-roe, garlic, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Lay a dumpling wrapper on a flat surface and place a small spoonful of the myeongnan-roe mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in the beaten egg and run it along the edge of the wrapper to help seal the dumpling.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
In a large donabe, bring the water to a boil and then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Carefully add the dumplings to the donabe, making sure they are not crowded.
Cover the donabe with a lid and steam the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they are cooked through and float to the surface.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
